_comment: Spoken-only pronunciation fixes. Key = word as written (case-insensitive, whole word). Value = a pronunciation hint like "thee-ah-cast" (Kokoro gets it joined, "Theeahcast"; the LTX presenter gets "Thee-ah-cast"), or {"tts": "...", "presenter": "..."} to set each engine explicitly. Captions/on-screen text keep the original spelling. Per-video overrides come from the chat ("X is pronounced Y"). Verified by ear 2026-10-09: TheiaCast is "THEE-uh-cast" (Theia, the Greek Titaness) — Kokoro: "Theea cast"; LTX presenter: "Thee-ah-cast"; VoxCPM2 (not wired in yet): "Theea cast" when cloning bf_alice, "Thia-cast" with its default voice.
